entry.title: New: Bill 2969 (Kauaʻi) — First Reading
entry.content:
For An Ordinance Amending Chapter 8, Article 27, Kaua‘i County Code 1987, As Amended, Relating To Shoreline Setback And Coastal Protection, to amend and update the Shoreline Setback Ordinance adopted in 2008 by adding definitions and safeguards that protect life and property and ensure the longevity and integrity of Kaua‘i’s coastal and beach resources along the shoreline

Latest action: On agenda 2026-02-04
